headline: Revenue and margins improve, EPS drop skewed by prior year
summary_short: IFF posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.954B (+1.8% y/y) with gross profit up 3.5% y/y to $853M and operating income up 11.3% y/y to $158M, while diluted EPS fell 91.4% y/y to $0.20 and net income dropped to $50M from $599M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 1.8% y/y to $1.954B. Gross profit grew 3.5% y/y to $853M and operating income rose 11.3% y/y to $158M — both outpacing revenue growth. EBITDA fell 60.8% y/y to $328M; net income fell 91.7% y/y to $50M; diluted EPS fell 91.4% y/y to $0.20. Total cash fell 30.3% y/y to $569M; long-term debt fell 16.7% y/y to $4.735B; shareholders' equity fell 3.0% y/y to $13.976B.
